Results.ReviewText: I love this BBQ.  It's the most expensive bbq I have ever purchased and it's worth every cent. Unlike my previous ones, I have yet to cook a bad meal on this one.  It heats evenly and quickly and is easy to clean.  I really enjoy the tank scale so you can see how much propane is left.  It also runs hot even when lot on gas.
Results.Title: A really great BBQ

Results.ReviewText: My first Weber was a Weber Genesis Silver-A that I purchased in June of 2000.  It finally gave up the ghost and there was no question what my next grill would be...it would be another Weber.  My Spirit E-310 is a wonderful upgrade.  There have been many improvements since 2000 and I am especially impressed with the cast iron, coated grate, which is reversible and easy to clean.  (I had to replace the grate more than once on my old one...they were thin and rested out easily.)  This model has 4 swivel (2 front-locking) casters which makes rolling it around so much easier and smoother as opposed to two legs on one side and two wheels on the other.  Assembly was easy and I love the door closure that hides the propane tank.  I've only been able to use it 4 times since I've purchased it...but I already love it and am now motivated to try things on this one that I might not have tried on my old one.
Results.Title: Once a Weber owner...always a Weber owner...

Results.ReviewText: We love to cook on the Weber grill.  Before purchasing, we did research and checked reviews.  We agree with most users that the grill is great. No hot spots so food is evenly cooked.  There were only 2 minor complaints, but not a reason to not purchase.  First, the box arrived in great condition.  However, when the parts were taken out, the base the wheels are on was dented.  We had to press it down in order for all the wheels to be touching the ground.  Also, the top of the cabinet door had a big dent it in it.  We could not straighten it out but it is not noticeable unless the door is open. These two incidents had to have happened on the manufacturing end and there are videos showing we are not the only ones to receive these dented items. For the price, I expected better.  Secondly, the propane tank scale is a great feature, but apparently all tanks aren't created equally.  All of our tanks have wider lips and cannot catch on the scale.  We remedied it by turning the tank around 45 degrees so that the back hole would catch on it.  It's pushing the limit on the hose, but it works.  Either a wider lip on the scale or a hose an inch longer would be better.  Still, we love the grill.
Results.Title: Love it, but it comes with dents

46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.
